last_result.reason: Adds a model-free live-path zone-entry evaluator (backend/scripts/eval/live_zone_entry.py) that replays recorded tracks through the same RuleEngine + ZoneEntryRule path used by CVWorker, plus 6 regression tests covering concave polygon geometry, entry direction, re-entry, event matching/schema round-trip, and the worker incident path.

current.goal: Fix the largest measured zone-entry accuracy gap without touching live camera configuration or frontend code.
current.exit: Measured improvement and no test regression.
